title: Follow Shot
description: A follow shot trails a moving subject at a fixed offset, usually from behind. The back of the head becomes foreground and the world opens ahead, so pursuit, haunting, or arrival is felt as walking into space.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: You are taken with them, not shown beside them. Doorways reveal themselves as they would to a stalker or a guardian.

The face is withheld, which can be predatory or intimate depending on distance and height. It is the wrong tool when the audience must read both faces of a conversation, and the wrong tool if the camera is bolted to the chest looking back at the actor.
Behind is a choice; body-mount is another.

sections.title: How it works

blocks.text: Match movement through the space at a fixed offset. Steadicam, gimbal, or handheld can execute it; the grammar is the trailing station, not the vest.
Keep the head as a stable foreground mass. Prompt a follow shot behind the subject, camera trailing at a fixed offset, back of the head as foreground, the world opening ahead.

sections.title: When to use it

blocks.text: Use it for pursuit, haunting, or walking someone into a room. Concrete beat: behind a child on a tricycle as the corridor keeps producing corners.
Do not follow if the scene is a two-hander that needs eyes.

sections.title: Compared with similar shots

blocks.text: Tracking Shot often rides beside and shows the body's full action. Steadicam is a common support for follow.
A SnorriCam is mounted to the performer and faces them, so the face is pinned and the world sloshes. Follow looks at their back, not into their face from a chest rig.
Tracking ShotAccompany a walker. The shot is a journey, not a picture.

sections.title: In film

blocks.text: The Shining puts us behind Danny in the hotel so corners arrive as he arrives. Enter the Void uses trailing and floating follow as afterlife grammar.
Goodfellas' Copa entrance is a follow that becomes a social descent into a room. Path grammar, not a hotel to rebuild.

sections.title: What usually goes wrong

blocks.text: The usual wrong cousin is a side Tracking Shot shot or a SnorriCam. The tell is a full profile, or a pinned face with a sliding world.
The fix: behind, fixed offset, head as foreground, space opening ahead.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is Follow Shot in film?
It is a camera that trails a mover, usually from behind, matching their path so we enter rooms as they do.
Follow Shot vs Tracking Shot
Tracking is the family of subject-locked travel and is often lateral. Follow specifies the trailing station: back of the head, world ahead.
When should I use Follow Shot?
When pursuit or entrance should be experienced from behind. Do not use it when both faces of a talk must read.
How do I prompt Follow Shot for AI image or video?
Write camera follows behind [Subject], fixed offset, back of the head in foreground, matching movement. Ban a side track and ban a chest-mounted face cam.
